newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber ends mostly firmer on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber ends mostly firmer on short-covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly firmer except for the spot July contract on Friday, lifted by short-covering ahead of the weekend as the yen retreated against the dollar later in the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.6 yen down to 1.0 yen higher. Benchmark December was up 0.7 yen at 122.0 yen.

"The market started lower on near-term oversupply trends, but most prices entered positive territory amid concern that the recent price falls may have been too rapid, as well as the yen's retreat," one trader said. "Fundamental sentiment remains bearish," he said.
